v1.39.7 (4 November 2024) |feed_title = 🎃 The Hexscape Event (Night III) 🎃 |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v1.38.0|Hexscape Night II Update]] |next_update = [[v1.40.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.39.0''' is the ninety-second update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 30th of October 2024. This update was also given the name '''Hexscape Night III Update''', as this update added the [[Containment|third night]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]. This update encompassed nine updates, the main v1.39.0 update (released 30 October 2024) and six minor updates, v1.39.1 (released 30 October 2024), v1.39.2 (released 30 October 2024), v1.39.3 (released 30 October 2024), v1.39.3a (released 1 November 2024), v1.39.4 (released 1 November 2024), v1.39.5 (released 2 November 2024), v1.39.6 (released 4 November 2024) and v1.39.7 (released 4 November 2024). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Hallow Punk]] *[[Harvester]] ===Enemies=== *[[Cursed Horror]] *[[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]] *[[Eclipsed (Hexscape)|Eclipsed]] *[[Hex Drako]] *[[Corrupted Titus]] *[[Hex Weaver]] *[[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Corrupted Conserver]] *[[Withered (Hexscape)|Withered]] *[[Reaper (Hexscape)|Reaper]] *[[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] *[[Unknown Small]] *[[Unknown Boss]] ===Maps=== *[[Containment]] ===Miscellanous=== *Two new skins obtained from [[Mission Quests]]. **[[Slasher]]: {{Color|EventMission|Jason}} **[[Harvester]]: {{Color|EventMission|Wasteland}} *[[Primordial Drakobloxxer (Narrator)|Primordial Drakobloxxer]] narrator ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Slasher]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Level 0''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|1,500}} to {{Money|1,250}}. ****Damage decreased from 6 to 5. ****Critical hit multiplier increased from 2 to 2.5. ***'''Level 1''' ****Damage increased from +0 to +1. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|3,500}} to {{Money|3,000}}. ****Critical hit multiplier increased from +0 to +0.5. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|7,000}} to {{Money|6,500}}. *[[Farm]] changed. **Now generates thorns when a [[Harvester]] that has it in its range uses its ''Thorns'' ability. Thorn statistics are a percentage of the [[Harvester]]'s statistic, based on its thorn power statistic. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Thorn power of 50% added. ***'''Level 1''' ****Thorn power increase of +10% added. ***'''Level 2''' ****Thorn power increase of +10% added. ***'''Level 3''' ****Thorn power increase of +10% added. ***'''Level 4''' ****Thorn power increase of +10% added. ***'''Level 5''' ****Thorn power increase of +10% added. *[[Slasher]] gamepass taken offsale. *[[Jester]] is now available through a limited time gamepass for {{Robux|799}}. *[[Conserver]] buffed. **Health increased from 400,000 to 425,000 in Hard difficulty. **Speed slightly increased from 1.25 to 1.3 **Cash given changed from {{Money|40,000}} to {{Money|7,500}} every 5% health lost. *Collected currency now displays the number of currency gained instead of how many items were picked up from the ground. *[[Bloated]] now increased enemy size by 50% instead of randomly between 15% and 25%. *Increased number of [[Mission Quests]] available from three to five. **''Wednesday the 30th'' and ''Dark Harvest'' are always the first two. *Changed image capture button to no longer be Halloween themed. *Fixed [[Gatling Gun]] not dealing damage to the [[Hex Corpse|Lower Body]]. *Fixed [[Mercenary Base]] unit lifespans getting halved after the unit gets upgraded for the first time. *Fixed [[Golden Crook Boss]] units having a lifespan of 100 instead of their intended lifespans. *Fixed [[Ranger]] having an incorrect firerate at Level 3. *Fixed [[Ace Pilot]] not displaying that it gets the ability to give towers in its secondary range hidden detection at Level 4. *Fixed {{Color|Other|Mako}} [[DJ Booth]] sometimes creating a large grey sphere when upgraded to Level 5. :In '''v1.39.1''': *Fixed triumphs not being tracked correctly for the Triumpher of All Nights badge. *Fixed [[Robux Shop]] selling the [[Hallow Punk]] tower instead of the [[Harvester]]. :In '''v1.39.2''': *Fixed some cutscenes not playing in [[Containment]]. :In '''v1.39.3''': *Fixed restarting in [[Containment]] removing [[Harvester]] from loadouts. :In '''v1.39.3a''': *Increased [[Conserver]]'s cash given from {{Money|7,500}} to {{Money|40,000}} every 5% health lost. :In '''v1.39.4''': *Enabled [[Battlepass Boost]] modifier on all maps. *Fixed [[Reaper (Hexscape)|Reaper]] floating slightly above the ground when [[Bloated]]. :In '''v1.39.5''': *Version number changed from ''v1.39.4'' to ''v1.39.5''. :In '''v1.39.6''': *Disabled [[Battlepass Boost]] on all maps. *[[Conserver]] nerfed. **Health decreased from 425,000 to 400,000. **Speed slightly decreased from 1.3 to 1.25. :In '''v1.39.7''': *Fixed [[Nimble]] no longer working after an effect that slows down enemies or burn ended. *Fixed [[Gatling Gun]] shooting much slower than intended when its firerate is altered, such as through the [[Commander]] or [[Time Scale]]. *Fixed [[Containment]] not giving any {{Coins|Coins}} while playing on the Hard difficulty. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight3Thumbnail.png HexscapeNight2Thumbnail.png TheHauntThumbnail.png
